cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent initiative. Approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Welcome to my garage sale. Your offer to browse is accepted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's my garage. You're helping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you're doing very well under my supervision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.text: Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we celebrate afterwards?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're choosing the trophy and postponing us. Say which.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you leave before your name is called? That's the choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're making me look selfish.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you give me your first turn, even if it costs you the match?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I do that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. You said you were on my side. This side has a cost.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant emotionally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lend the emotion a turn so I can see it.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why does it matter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not demanding a rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved the soup. You may start lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was asking whether you'd pass the salt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is under consideration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll get it myself.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Take five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Concede that one ball was out. You can keep the match.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why does it matter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like one corner of reality returned to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not demanding a rematch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just say 'out' without attaching your trophy to it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit I found the restaurant. You can keep credit for the whole holiday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also complained about the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Different claim. I'm not filing it today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You found it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. The rest of your glorious itinerary remains untouched.
